description: Wavetable oscillator with a phase shaper, an output mangler, a low-pass gate, a sub oscillator and two FM channels, playing 64 built-in wavetables or eight banks of your own

params.text: Shifts the oscillator by up to three octaves either way
Tunes the oscillator across an octave either way
Tunes the oscillator up or down by half a semitone
Chooses the wavetable, one of 64 built in, or one of the eight user banks while User is lit
Scans through the waves of the chosen table, crossfading between neighbouring waves
Chooses one of 27 ways to bend the phase that reads the wavetable, from Bend and Tilt through mirroring, stepping, buzzing and rising or falling sine shapes
Sets how far the phase shaper bends the wave, leaving it untouched fully counter-clockwise
Chooses one of eleven ways to mangle the oscillator's output: bit crushing, quantising, three bitwise operations, overdrive, ring modulation, sharpening, sine shaping, folding or mirroring
Sets how strongly the enhancer mangles the output, leaving it untouched fully counter-clockwise
Sets how quickly the low-pass gate opens when it is triggered
Sets how quickly the low-pass gate closes once it has opened
Feeds the oscillator's output back into its own phase, bending the wave into harder shapes; with a cable in the skew input this knob attenuates that CV instead and the fixed amount drops to zero
Sets how much sub oscillator is mixed into the main output; the sub output jack carries it at full level whatever this is set to
Crossfades the sub oscillator's shape from sine through sawtooth and square to a square that flips on each cycle of the main wave
Attenuates and inverts a V/Oct input; fully clockwise that input moves the pitch an octave per volt
Attenuates and inverts a bank CV; 10V at full depth steps through every bank
Attenuates and inverts a wave CV; 10V at full depth scans the whole table
Attenuates and inverts a shaper type CV; 10V at full depth runs through every shaper type
Attenuates and inverts a shaper depth CV; 10V at full depth covers the whole depth range
Attenuates and inverts an enhancer type CV; 10V at full depth runs through every enhancer type
Attenuates and inverts an enhancer depth CV; 10V at full depth covers the whole depth range
Attenuates and inverts an attack CV; 10V at full depth covers the whole attack range
Attenuates and inverts a decay CV; 10V at full depth covers the whole decay range
Attenuates the CV at its own FM VCA input, which sets the depth of that FM channel; with nothing patched there that channel stays wide open
Sets how much of its own FM input reaches the oscillator
Steps the low-pass gate through VCA, filter and both, lit red, green and blue in turn; held for half a second it takes the gate out of the signal path and puts it back
Lengthens the range of the low-pass gate's attack and decay
Makes the voltage at the low-pass gate's trigger inputs set how far it opens, in place of treating anything positive as fully open
Makes the low-pass gate run as a one-shot, so its attack and decay play out whatever the length of the trigger
Plays from the eight user wavetable banks in place of the 64 built-in ones
Restricts its own sync input to the first quarter of the oscillator's cycle, which softens the sync
Switches the FM channels from phase modulation to true frequency modulation, at 1000Hz per unit of the summed FM signal
Puts the low-pass gate before the enhancer rather than after it
Divides the oscillator frequency by 100 and lets the main and raw outputs pass DC, which turns the module into an LFO
Holds the oscillator frequency at zero and resets its phase, leaving FM, skew and sync the only things that move it
Applies the phase shaper after the FM has been added to the phase rather than before it
Makes the displays show each value with its CV added, rather than the knob position alone

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave through its own attenuverter
Moves through the wavetable banks through its own attenuverter, 10V at full depth covering all of them
Scans through the waves of the table through its own attenuverter, 10V at full depth covering the whole table
Moves through the shaper types through its own attenuverter
Adds to the shaper depth through its own attenuverter
Moves through the enhancer types through its own attenuverter
Adds to the enhancer depth through its own attenuverter
Sets the depth of its own FM channel through its own attenuator; with nothing patched here that channel is wide open
An FM signal into the oscillator at the level set by its own knob, as phase modulation or, with True lit, as frequency modulation
A rising edge resets the oscillator's phase in the manner set by the sync mode display
Adds to the low-pass gate's attack through its own attenuverter
Adds to the low-pass gate's decay through its own attenuverter
Opens the low-pass gate; with Velo lit the voltage here sets how far it opens, a tenth of the voltage being full
Bends the wave by feeding the oscillator's output back into its phase, by the amount the Skew knob sets for this jack

outputs.text: The oscillator's own ramp, rising from -5V to 5V over each cycle
A 5V pulse each time the oscillator's phase wraps round
The phase after the shaper has bent it, a ramp between -5V and 5V
The wavetable's output before the enhancer and the low-pass gate, 5V peak and DC blocked
The enhancer's own output, 5V peak and DC blocked
The sub oscillator an octave below the main one, 5V peak
The voice output: wavetable, enhancer, sub oscillator and low-pass gate together, 5V peak, or 12dB quieter when the menu says so

notes: the eight user banks are empty when the module is placed and hold silence, so loading WAV files through the User Bank Manager comes before switching the oscillator over to user waves
the three name displays open the lists of wavetable banks, shaper types and enhancer types, so a table or a type can be picked by name rather than by turning its knob
the sync mode display chooses what a sync pulse does: hard sync, a fifth, an octave up or down, rise, fall, pull, push, hold, one shot, lock shot or reverse
menu: Open — under the User Bank Manager heading, replaces the panel with the wavetable editor, where WAV files are read into the eight user banks, renamed, cloned and exported
Number of voices — under the Voicing heading, sets the polyphony, from automatic to a fixed count up to sixteen
Reduce level by 12dB — under the Output level heading, drops the main output from 5V peak to about 1.25V
Red LED — under the Display style heading, colours the panel's readouts; Yellow LED, Green LED, Blue LED and White LED are the other choices
